summary: Georgia lookout list places a tower named leary in Calhoun County; no source gives its history or describes the site today.

evidence.supports: List row for leary: Calhoun County, coordinates, and an elevation of 221 with no unit stated; the gfc-202 code
The list's names for towers numbered 73 and above are its own creation; this entry is number 79
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The list marks some entries as historical
The list's Google map was revised on March 22, 2016
The list explains the gfc-nnn code form: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn)

notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list. Two web searches and one more check found no build, staffing, fire or fate history for a Leary tower. The Georgia index of the National Historic Lookout Register (29 registered lookouts, read from the cache) and the Eastern U.S. Lookouts Georgia directory list no Leary tower. The list gives the elevation with no unit; the record's 67.4 m assumes feet (221 ft). The list explains the gfc-nnn code form (towers in an older GFC list of locations), so the GFC label is sourced, not an interpretation. Unverified search lead, not a lookout: an antenna database entry for a 250-ft structure in Leary. Story is about 143 words because the evidence is thin. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the codes were previously called unexplained; the page explains gfc-nnn.
